prompt_en: Photograph an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and composed focus. At dawn inside an abandoned planetarium converted into a fitting room, she performs a zero-gravity stage work while two adult artisans shape her individual basted toile. Couture atelier craft is shown through a basted toile for one client. Pins, chalked balance lines, and temporary seams show live fit corrections; fit correction pins and balance lines remain legible across the bodice and hip. One artisan hand-drapes a translucent silk layer; an opened side section reveals visible internal support layers: boning, canvas, organza, and layered understructure. The second artisan performs hand-attached embroidery, securing one small constellation to the same developing garment. Frame the woman's full working silhouette, both artisans' hands, the toile, exposed construction, and embroidery contact in a three-quarter scene. A translucent silk sweep in the foreground, fitting action in the midground, and the dome behind create legible depth; cool projected constellations and warm task lamps trace fabric edges through haze.
negative_en: unrealistic hands, excessive HDR, low resolution, 3D render look, fake-looking background, body distortion, distorted fingers, cartoon style
